description: Source code for the torch.dtype Python extension type, defining its methods, properties, and initialization in C++.

classes.name: THPDtype
classes.description: Python extension type representing torch data types.

methods.name: THPDtype_New
methods.description: Creates a new torch dtype object with specified scalar type and name.

methods.name: THPDtype_is_floating_point
methods.description: Checks if the dtype is a floating point type.

methods.name: THPDtype_itemsize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the dtype.

methods.name: THPDtype_is_complex
methods.description: Checks if the dtype is a complex type.

methods.name: THPDtype_is_signed
methods.description: Checks if the dtype is signed.

methods.name: THPDtype_reduce
methods.description: Returns the name of the dtype for pickling.

methods.name: THPDtype_to_real
methods.description: Converts dtype to its real value type if necessary.

methods.name: THPDtype_to_complex
methods.description: Converts dtype to its complex type if necessary.

methods.name: THPDtype_repr
methods.description: Returns string representation of the dtype.

methods.description: Initializes the torch.dtype type and adds it to the module.
